dimensions.detail: The artifacts consistently describe a lore and mythic-persona aid using bundled Eternal Haven books and reference markdown; the files match that purpose.

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are scoped to Eternal Haven, Champion-style voice, targeted local reads, canon labeling, and copyright-aware summaries; they explicitly forbid off-bundle paths and full-book dumping.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill includes a standard ClawHub npx install command and mentions related LYGO skills as suggested pairings, but it also says not to auto-install other skills.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The package is markdown and plain text with no executable files or required network calls. Optional support URLs are present, including PayPal and Patreon, but instructions gate them behind explicit user requests and forbid payment or wallet actions.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background workers, privileged commands, credential/session access, broad local indexing, mutation authority, or wallet transaction behavior was found.

llm.findings:
[SkillSpector.clean] expected: SkillSpector reported no issues; local review supports this because the package contains only lore/reference text and scoped agent guidance.
[VirusTotal.clean] expected: VirusTotal telemetry shows no malicious or suspicious engine detections; this is consistent with the artifact inspection but was not used as the sole basis for the verdict.
[static.local_file_inventory] expected: All inspected artifact files are markdown or plain text, none are executable, and local hashes match the metadata for the listed files.
[support_links.optional] expected: Payment/support links are present, but the skill repeatedly instructs agents to share them only when the user explicitly asks and not to initiate payment, crypto, or wallet flows.
[related_skills.references] expected: References to LYGO champion/operator skills are framed as optional integration order and tone pairing, with explicit statements that this pack grants no operator permissions and should not auto-install anything.
llm.guidance: Install this if you want Eternal Haven lore and mythic persona context. Agents should keep reads inside the bundled skill folder, use summaries or short quotes rather than reproducing books, and only surface support links if you ask for them.
llm.summary: This is a read-only Eternal Haven lore reference pack, and I found no hidden code, credential access, or automatic actions.
